# Know who cleans what, which turnovers will fail, and how many cleaners you need.

> Free Airbnb and VRBO turnover cleaning scheduler: paste your iCal calendars and get a cleaner schedule, same-day turnover warnings, double-booking checks and the number of cleaners you need. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
